rules.name: Technology marker inventory
rules.description: Reuse existing assessment to discover top-level stack hints, without requiring a particular stack.

rules.name: Governance and alternative documentation inventory
rules.description: Discover standard paths and existing documentation candidates; human review establishes equivalence. Absence does not establish a code quality defect.

rules.name: Project metadata validation
rules.description: Validate existing docs/project.json against the unchanged canonical project schema, including date formats.

rules.name: CI, build and test configuration inventory
rules.description: Discover recognizable configuration and test candidates. Do not execute commands or infer that gates pass.

rules.name: Local documentation reference integrity
rules.description: Check explicit relative Markdown file links and task context paths. Report unverifiable references rather than assuming success.
